newsitem.title: USA: Krystal says emerges from Chapter 11.
newsitem.headline: Krystal says emerges from Chapter 11.

text.p: Krystal said Thursday its plan of reorganization was confirmed on April 10, allowing it to emerge from Chapter 11 on April 23.

Krystal sought Chapter 11 protection to resolve all Fair Labor Standards Act wage claims filed against it and has previously announced settlement of those claims. Long said, "All other valid claims against the company will be paid in full under the terms of the plan of reorganization."

Krystal Co an operator and franchisor of quick-service hamburger restaurants, Thursday reported net income for the first quarter of $403,000, or $0.05 a share, versus a comparable net loss of $146,000, or $0.02 a share, for the first quarter of 1996, before deducting professional fees and other expenses in both periods related to the Chapter 11 proceedings and an extraordinary item charge in 1997 related to early extinguishment of debt.
These two unusual items reduced net income in the first quarter of 1997 by $0.09 a share and increased the net loss in the first quarter of 1996 by $0.08 a share.
